# BtnForge Task Outline & Design Notes

## Source Mapping

- **ColorLib Template**: Bootstrap Buttons 06
- **Source Slug**: `bootstrap-buttons-06`
- **Preview URL**: `https://preview.colorlib.com/theme/bb/bootstrap-buttons-06/`
- **New App Name**: `btnforge` (`@free-react-templates/btnforge`)
- **Deploy Domain**: `btnforge.free.componentdock.com`

## Section Structure & Order

1. `Navbar`: Header navigation with dark mode toggle.
2. `Hero`: Title banner (`#06 — Bootstrap 4 Buttons`).
3. `ButtonSizes`: Large, Medium, Small button variants.
4. `ButtonColors`: Full grid of 19+ color variants (Primary, Secondary, Success, Info, Warning, Danger, Light, Orange, Indigo, Pink, Deep Orange, Aqua, Dark, Black, Purple, Blue, Brown, Blue Gray, White).
5. `FullWidthButton`: Block button showcase.
6. `Footer`: Component Dock attribution link.

## Design Notes

- Clean layout with centered content cards and generous padding.
- Utilizes Tailwind CSS 4 with custom button classes matching Bootstrap color semantics and rounded corners (`rounded`).
